title: 阪神JFの後に・注目のウマ娘

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon does a great job at the Hanshin J.F. This not only piques the audience's interest in her, but also delights the younger students who come to watch, pushing Hishi Amazon's drive to a new high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, I'm troubled over about whether we should pursue the Triple Tiara tour or the Classic Triple Crown tour…
